заголовок: Nano Banana Pro: Gemini 3 Pro Image model from Google DeepMind
дата_в_тексте: Nov 20, 2025 (строка под заголовком); html: article:published_time 2025-11-20, dateModified 2026-03-19T17:48Z

официальность.второй_признак: автор из Google: Naina Raisinghani, Product Manager, Google DeepMind; текст от лица Google ('Today, we’re introducing'); AI-сводка помечена 'Summaries were generated by Google AI'.

картина: Главный потребительский анонс Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) в блоге Google от 20.11.2025 (автор — PM Google DeepMind), для широкой аудитории. Структура: вводная (построена на Gemini 3 Pro, reasoning + знания мира); три блока возможностей — 1) точные контекстные визуалы (инфографика, диаграммы, Search-grounding для рецептов/погоды/спорта), 2) точный многоязычный текст в кадре (от слогана до абзаца, шрифты/фактуры/каллиграфия, перевод), 3) высокое качество и креативный контроль (до 14 картинок и 5 людей; локальные правки, ракурс, фокус, цветокоррекция, свет; форматы и 2K/4K); где попробовать (Gemini app с моделью Thinking, лимиты free → откат на Nano Banana; Ads, Slides/Vids, API/AI Studio, Antigravity, Vertex, Flow); водяные знаки (SynthID везде, видимый 'Gemini sparkle' для free/Pro, без него для Ultra и AI Studio; проверка в Gemini app). 16 примеров промптов с подписями — главное сырьё страницы.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana (Gemini 2.5 Flash Image) was used for restoring old photos and generating mini figurines and was a big step in image editing for casual creators.
единицы.цитата: From restoring old photos to generating mini figurines , Nano Banana was a big step in image editing that empowered casual creators to express their creativity.
единицы.раздел: Introducing Nano Banana Pro (вводная)

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro (Gemini 3 Pro Image) is built on Gemini 3 Pro and uses Gemini’s state-of-the-art reasoning and real-world knowledge to visualize information better than before.
единицы.цитата: Built on Gemini 3 Pro , Nano Banana Pro uses Gemini’s state-of-the-art reasoning and real-world knowledge to visualize information better than ever before.
единицы.раздел: Introducing Nano Banana Pro (вводная)

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro can visualize ideas and designs from prototypes to data represented as infographics and handwritten notes turned into diagrams.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro can help you visualize any idea and design anything — from prototypes, to representing data as infographics, to turning handwritten notes into diagrams.
единицы.раздел: How Nano Banana Pro helps you bring any idea or design to life > Generate more accurate, context-rich visuals
единицы.заметка: Рукописные заметки — входное изображение → диаграмма.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro can create accurate educational explainers such as context-rich infographics and diagrams based on the content you provide or on facts from the real world.
единицы.цитата: You can get accurate educational explainers to learn more about a new subject, like context-rich infographics and diagrams based on the content you provide or facts from the real world.
единицы.раздел: How Nano Banana Pro helps you bring any idea or design to life > Generate more accurate, context-rich visuals
единицы.заметка: Два источника фактов: материал пользователя или знания о мире.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro can connect to Google Search's knowledge base to create a quick snapshot for a recipe or visualize real-time information like weather or sports.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro can also connect to Google Search's vast knowledge base to help you create a quick snapshot for a recipe or visualize real-time information like weather or sports.
единицы.раздел: How Nano Banana Pro helps you bring any idea or design to life > Generate more accurate, context-rich visuals

единицы.утверждение_en: Example (with an input photo of a plant): "Create an infographic about this plant focusing on interesting information." — result: an infographic on the String of Turtles house plant with origins, care essentials and growth patterns.
единицы.цитата: Create an infographic about this plant focusing on interesting information.
единицы.раздел: How Nano Banana Pro helps you bring any idea or design to life > Generate more accurate, context-rich visuals
единицы.заметка: Структура: 'Create an infographic' (тип результата) + 'about this plant' (объект с входного фото, указательное 'this') + 'focusing on interesting information' (фокус содержания). Какие факты — выбирает модель из знаний о растении (подпись: происхождение, уход, рост).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example: "Create an infographic that shows how to make elaichi chai" — result: a step-by-step infographic for cardamom tea, showing the ability to visualize recipes and real-world information.
единицы.цитата: Create an infographic that shows how to make elaichi chai
единицы.раздел: How Nano Banana Pro helps you bring any idea or design to life > Generate more accurate, context-rich visuals
единицы.заметка: Структура: тип результата + процесс ('shows how to make') + конкретное блюдо; шаги и оформление не задаются — модель достраивает рецепт из знаний.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro was used to pull in real-time weather via Search grounding to build a pop-art infographic.
единицы.цитата: We used Nano Banana Pro to pull in real-time weather via Search grounding to build a pop-art infographic.
единицы.раздел: How Nano Banana Pro helps you bring any idea or design to life > Generate more accurate, context-rich visuals
единицы.заметка: Текст промпта не приведён.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is described as the best model for creating images with correctly rendered and legible text directly in the image, from a short tagline to a long paragraph.
единицы.цитата: Nano Banana Pro is the best model for creating images with correctly rendered and legible text directly in the image, whether you’re looking for a short tagline, or a long paragraph.
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages

единицы.утверждение_en: You can create more detailed text in mockups or posters with a wider variety of textures, fonts and calligraphy.
единицы.цитата: Now you can create more detailed text in mockups or posters with a wider variety of textures, fonts and calligraphy.
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages
единицы.заметка: Опора — 'Gemini 3 is great at understanding depth and nuance' (та же строка).

единицы.утверждение_en: With Gemini’s enhanced multilingual reasoning, you can generate text in multiple languages or localize and translate content.
единицы.цитата: With Gemini’s enhanced multilingual reasoning, you can generate text in multiple languages, or localize and translate your content so you can scale internationally and/or share content more easily with friends and family.
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages

единицы.утверждение_en: Example: "Create a storyboard for this scene" — result: a black-and-white storyboard sketch with an establishing shot, medium shot, close-up and POV shot for a film scene.
единицы.цитата: Create a storyboard for this scene
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages
единицы.заметка: Структура: тип результата ('storyboard') + указательное 'this scene' (сцена задана входом — картинкой или описанием, страница не уточняет). Набор планов (establishing/medium/close-up/POV) модель выбирает сама.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example text-in-architecture prompt: "View of a cozy street in Berlin on a bright sunny day, stark shadows. the old houses are oddly shaped like letters that spell out "BERLIN" Colored in Blue, Red, White and black. The houses still look like houses and the resemblance to letters is subtle."
единицы.цитата: View of a cozy street in Berlin on a bright sunny day, stark shadows. the old houses are oddly shaped like letters that spell out "BERLIN" Colored in Blue, Red, White and black. The houses still look like houses and the resemblance to letters is subtle.
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages
единицы.заметка: Порядок: вид/сцена ('View of a cozy street in Berlin') → время/свет ('bright sunny day, stark shadows') → приём встраивания текста (дома в форме букв) → слово в кавычках "BERLIN" → цвета → ограничитель меры ('The houses still look like houses and the resemblance to letters is subtle'). Последняя фраза управляет силой эффекта. Регистр и пунктуация небрежные — модель это прощает.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example calligraphy/logo prompt: "make 8 minimalistic logos, each is an expressive word, and make letters convey a message or sound visually to express the meaning of this word in a dramatic way. composition: flat vector rendering of all logos in black on a single white background"
единицы.цитата: make 8 minimalistic logos, each is an expressive word, and make letters convey a message or sound visually to express the meaning of this word in a dramatic way. composition: flat vector rendering of all logos in black on a single white background
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages
единицы.заметка: Структура как у шаблона 'N логотипов': количество+стиль → содержание элемента ('each is an expressive word') → способ передачи смысла буквами ('convey a message or sound visually ... in a dramatic way') → поле 'composition:' (flat vector, чёрным, на одном белом фоне). Слова выбирает модель (по alt: Crash, whoosh, shiver, bang, drip, squeeze, roar, wobble).

единицы.утверждение_en: Example translation edit prompt: "translate all the English text on the three yellow and blue cans into Korean, while keeping everything else the same"
единицы.цитата: translate all the English text on the three yellow and blue cans into Korean, while keeping everything else the same
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages
единицы.заметка: Структура: операция ('translate all the English text') + точная адресация объекта на входной картинке ('on the three yellow and blue cans') + целевой язык ('into Korean') + оговорка сохранения ('while keeping everything else the same').

единицы.утверждение_en: Example typographic design prompt: "A vibrant, eye-catching "TYPOGRAPHY" design on a textured off-white background. The letters are bold, blocky, extra condensed and create a 3D effect with overlapping layers of bright blue and hot pink, each with a halftone dot pattern, evoking a retro print aesthetic. 16:9 aspect ratio"
единицы.цитата: A vibrant, eye-catching "TYPOGRAPHY" design on a textured off-white background. The letters are bold, blocky, extra condensed and create a 3D effect with overlapping layers of bright blue and hot pink, each with a halftone dot pattern, evoking a retro print aesthetic. 16:9 aspect ratio
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages
единицы.заметка: Порядок: общий характер + слово в кавычках + фон → форма букв (bold, blocky, extra condensed) → эффект и цвета (3D, overlapping layers, bright blue и hot pink, halftone dot pattern) → эстетика ('retro print aesthetic') → формат в конце ('16:9 aspect ratio') прямо в тексте промпта.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example: "Create an image showing the phrase "How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood" made out of wood chucked by a woodchuck." — blending text and texture in a woodchopping scene.
единицы.цитата: Create an image showing the phrase "How much wood would a woodchuck chuck if a woodchuck could chuck wood" made out of wood chucked by a woodchuck.
единицы.раздел: … > Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text directly in the image in multiple languages
единицы.заметка: Длинная фраза в кавычках + материал букв ('made out of wood') + смысловая связь со сценой ('chucked by a woodchuck'). Показывает рендер длинного текста (скороговорка из 12 слов).

единицы.утверждение_en: With Nano Banana Pro you can blend more elements than before, using up to 14 images and maintaining the consistency and resemblance of up to 5 people.
единицы.цитата: Consistency by design: With Nano Banana Pro, you can blend more elements than ever before, using up to 14 images and maintaining the consistency and resemblance of up to 5 people.
единицы.раздел: … > Create high-fidelity visuals with upgraded creative capabilities > Consistency by design

единицы.утверждение_en: Use Nano Banana Pro to turn sketches into products or blueprints into photorealistic 3D structures.
единицы.цитата: Whether turning sketches into products or blueprints into photorealistic 3D structures, you can now bridge the gap between concept and creation.
единицы.раздел: … > Create high-fidelity visuals with upgraded creative capabilities > Consistency by design

единицы.утверждение_en: Apply the desired visual look and feel to mockups so that branding remains consistent across every touchpoint.
единицы.цитата: Apply your desired visual look and feel to your mockups with ease, ensuring your branding remains seamless and consistent across every touchpoint.
единицы.раздел: … > Create high-fidelity visuals with upgraded creative capabilities > Consistency by design

единицы.утверждение_en: Example multi-reference scene prompt (14 character inputs): "A medium shot of the 14 fluffy characters sitting squeezed together side-by-side on a worn beige fabric sofa and on the floor. They are all facing forwards, watching a vintage, wooden-boxed television set placed on a low wooden table in front of the sofa. The room is dimly lit, with warm light from a window on the left and the glow from the TV illuminating the creatures' faces and fluffy textures. The background is a cozy, slightly cluttered living room with a braided rug, a bookshelf with old books, and rustic kitchen elements in the background. The overall atmosphere is warm, cozy, and amused."
единицы.цитата: A medium shot of the 14 fluffy characters sitting squeezed together side-by-side on a worn beige fabric sofa and on the floor. They are all facing forwards, watching a vintage, wooden-boxed television set placed on a low wooden table in front of the sofa. The room is dimly lit, with warm light from a window on the left and the glow from the TV illuminating the creatures' faces and fluffy textures. The background is a cozy, slightly cluttered living room with a braided rug, a bookshelf with old books, and rustic kitchen elements in the background. The overall atmosphere is warm, cozy, and amused.
единицы.раздел: … > Create high-fidelity visuals with upgraded creative capabilities > Consistency by design
единицы.заметка: Подпись: 'Maintaining the consistency of up to 14 inputs, including multiple characters'. Порядок: план ('A medium shot') → субъекты с числом ('the 14 fluffy characters') и расстановка → направление взгляда/действие → ключевой объект сцены → свет с источниками и направлением ('warm light from a window on the left', 'glow from the TV illuminating the creatures' faces') → фон с деталями → общая атмосфера. Персонажи не описываются — берутся с референсов.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example multi-image composition with an edit: "Combine these images into one appropriately arranged cinematic image in 16:9 format and change the dress on the mannequin to the dress in the image"
единицы.цитата: Combine these images into one appropriately arranged cinematic image in 16:9 format and change the dress on the mannequin to the dress in the image
единицы.раздел: … > Create high-fidelity visuals with upgraded creative capabilities > Consistency by design
единицы.заметка: Подпись: 'Craft lifestyle scenes by combining multiple elements' (alt: платье, растения, кресло). Структура: операция объединения + требование к раскладке ('appropriately arranged') + стиль ('cinematic') + формат ('in 16:9 format') + вторая операция — замена платья на манекене платьем с референса.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example multi-image composition: "Combine these images into one appropriately arranged cinematic image in 16:9 format" — used to create surreal landscapes by combining multiple input elements.
единицы.цитата: Combine these images into one appropriately arranged cinematic image in 16:9 format
единицы.раздел: … > Create high-fidelity visuals with upgraded creative capabilities > Consistency by design
единицы.заметка: Тот же шаблон, что E-139-22, без второй операции: универсальная формула объединения референсов.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example identity-preserving group prompt (5 people + a dog, 6 input photos): "Put these five people and this dog into a single image, they should fit into a stunning award-winning shot in the style if [sic] a fashion editorial. The identity of all five people and their attire and the dog must stay consistent throughout but they can and should be seen from different angles and distances in [sic] as is most natural and suitable to the scene. Make the colour and lighting look natural on them all, they look like they naturally fit into this fashion show."
единицы.цитата: Put these five people and this dog into a single image, they should fit into a stunning award-winning shot in the style if [sic] a fashion editorial. The identity of all five people and their attire and the dog must stay consistent throughout but they can and should be seen from different angles and distances in [sic] as is most natural and suitable to the scene. Make the colour and lighting look natural on them all, they look like they naturally fit into this fashion show.
единицы.раздел: … > Create high-fidelity visuals with upgraded creative capabilities > Consistency by design
единицы.заметка: Структура: 1) состав (five people + this dog → одна картинка); 2) жанр/уровень ('award-winning shot', 'fashion editorial'); 3) жёсткое требование сохранения ('identity ... and their attire ... must stay consistent'); 4) разрешённая свобода ('can and should be seen from different angles and distances'); 5) согласование света и цвета ('Make the colour and lighting look natural on them all'). Опечатки '[sic]' — в оригинале Google.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro improves localized editing: you can select, refine and transform any part of an image.
единицы.цитата: Select, refine and transform any part of an image with improved localized editing.
единицы.раздел: … > Studio-quality creative controls

единицы.утверждение_en: You can adjust camera angles, change the focus, apply sophisticated color grading, or transform scene lighting (for example changing day to night or creating a bokeh effect).
единицы.цитата: Adjust camera angles, change the focus and apply sophisticated color grading, or even transform scene lighting (e.g. changing day to night or creating a bokeh effect).
единицы.раздел: … > Studio-quality creative controls

единицы.утверждение_en: Outputs can be prepared for any platform, from social media to print, thanks to a range of aspect ratios and available 2K and 4K resolution.
единицы.цитата: Your creations are ready for any platform, from social media to print, thanks to a range of available aspect ratios and available 2K and 4K resolution
единицы.раздел: … > Studio-quality creative controls
единицы.заметка: Конкретные соотношения не перечислены.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example aspect-ratio change prompt: "change aspect ratio to 1:1 by reducing background. The character, remains exactly locked in its current position"
единицы.цитата: change aspect ratio to 1:1 by reducing background. The character, remains exactly locked in its current position
единицы.раздел: … > Studio-quality creative controls
единицы.заметка: Структура: операция + целевое соотношение ('to 1:1') + способ ('by reducing background') + закрепление главного объекта ('remains exactly locked in its current position'). Подпись: смена формата под разные платформы.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example lighting edit prompt: "Turn this scene into nighttime" — lighting and focus controls transform a scene from day to night.
единицы.цитата: Turn this scene into nighttime
единицы.раздел: … > Studio-quality creative controls
единицы.заметка: Три слова смысла: 'Turn' + 'this scene' + целевое состояние 'nighttime'. Alt: лиса в снегу днём и ночью.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example dramatic-lighting prompt: "Generate an image with an intense chiaroscuro effect. The man should retain his original features and expression. Introduce harsh, directional light, appearing to come from above and slightly to the left, casting deep, defined shadows across the face. Only slivers of light illuminating his eyes and cheekbones, the rest of the face is in deep shadow."
единицы.цитата: Generate an image with an intense chiaroscuro effect. The man should retain his original features and expression. Introduce harsh, directional light, appearing to come from above and slightly to the left, casting deep, defined shadows across the face. Only slivers of light illuminating his eyes and cheekbones, the rest of the face is in deep shadow.
единицы.раздел: … > Studio-quality creative controls
единицы.заметка: Порядок: название эффекта ('intense chiaroscuro') → сохранение личности ('retain his original features and expression') → характер и направление света ('harsh, directional light ... from above and slightly to the left') → форма теней → что остаётся освещённым ('slivers of light ... eyes and cheekbones'). Подпись: затемнить/высветить часть кадра для драматичного эффекта.

единицы.утверждение_en: Example focus edit prompt: "Focus on the flowers" — adjusting depth of field or focal point.
единицы.цитата: Focus on the flowers
единицы.раздел: … > Studio-quality creative controls
единицы.заметка: Минимальная команда: глагол 'Focus on' + объект; alt: фокус переносится с женщины в поле цветов на цветы на переднем плане.

единицы.утверждение_en: Across Google products you can choose the original Nano Banana for fast, fun editing, or Nano Banana Pro for complex compositions requiring the highest quality and visually sophisticated results.
единицы.цитата: Across our products and services, you now have a choice: the original Nano Banana for fast, fun editing, or Nano Banana Pro for complex compositions requiring the highest quality and visually sophisticated results.
единицы.раздел: How you can try Nano Banana Pro today

единицы.утверждение_en: In the Gemini app, Nano Banana Pro is used when selecting 'Create images' with the 'Thinking' model; free-tier users get limited free quotas, after which they revert to the original Nano Banana, while Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers receive higher quotas.
единицы.цитата: Rolling out globally in the Gemini app when you select ‘Create images’ with the ‘Thinking’ model. Our free-tier users will receive limited free quotas, after which they will revert to the original Nano Banana model. Google AI Plus, Pro and Ultra subscribers receive higher quotas.
единицы.раздел: How you can try Nano Banana Pro today > Consumers and students
единицы.заметка: Состояние на 20.11.2025.

единицы.утверждение_en: Nano Banana Pro is available in AI Mode in Search in the U.S. for Google AI Pro and Ultra subscribers, and in NotebookLM for subscribers globally.

единицы.утверждение_en: You can upload an image into the Gemini app and ask whether it was generated by Google AI (SynthID verification); this starts with English-language prompts for images, with more languages, audio and video to follow.
единицы.цитата: you can now upload an image into the Gemini app and simply ask if it was generated by Google AI, thanks to SynthID technology. We are starting with English language prompts for images, and will expand to more languages, audio and video soon.
единицы.раздел: How to identify AI-generated images in the Gemini app

единицы.утверждение_en: Besides SynthID, a visible watermark (the Gemini sparkle) is kept on images generated by free and Google AI Pro tier users.
единицы.цитата: In addition to SynthID, we will maintain a visible watermark (the Gemini sparkle) on images generated by free and Google AI Pro tier users, to make images even more easy to detect as Google AI-generated.
единицы.раздел: How to identify AI-generated images in the Gemini app

единицы.утверждение_en: The visible watermark is removed from images generated by Google AI Ultra subscribers and within the Google AI Studio developer tool, to provide a clean canvas for professional work.
единицы.цитата: Recognizing the need for a clean visual canvas for professional work, we will remove the visible watermark from images generated by Google AI Ultra subscribers and within the Google AI Studio developer tool.
единицы.раздел: How to identify AI-generated images in the Gemini app
единицы.заметка: SynthID при этом остаётся (E-139-38).

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Edit prompts on the page are short imperatives that point at the input with "this/these" (Turn this scene into nighttime; Focus on the flowers; Create a storyboard for this scene; Combine these images…), and when something must not change they add an explicit preservation clause: "while keeping everything else the same", "remains exactly locked in its current position", "should retain his original features and expression", "identity … and their attire … must stay consistent".
длинная_дистанция.заметка: Правило, видимое только на всём наборе: операция + объект + (оговорка сохранения).

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: Long generation prompts follow a camera-to-mood order: shot or view first ("A medium shot of…", "View of a cozy street…"), then subjects and their arrangement, the setting, lighting with direction and sources, colours/background, and finally the overall atmosphere or format (e.g. "16:9 aspect ratio" at the end).

Text to be rendered is written in quotation marks inside the prompt ("BERLIN", "TYPOGRAPHY", the woodchuck phrase), followed by how the letters are built or integrated (houses shaped like letters, letters made of wood, bold blocky condensed letters) and, where needed, how strong the effect should be ("the resemblance to letters is subtle").
длинная_дистанция.раздел: Generate better visuals with more accurate, legible text…
длинная_дистанция.заметка: В логотипных промптах слова не даются — модель выбирает их сама (другой режим).

длинная_дистанция.утверждение_en: In the consumer examples the output format is stated inside the prompt text itself ("in 16:9 format", "16:9 aspect ratio", "change aspect ratio to 1:1 by reducing background"), not via a separate setting.
